books.title: The Next Useful Action
books.subtitle: A product vision for a browser that keeps up
books.subsystem: Begin with a familiar browser task, then reveal why predicting a bounded next action might feel faster than generating a whole instruction. Establish assistive focus and goal-directed automation as separate experiences.

books.title: One Read, Many Decisions
books.subtitle: Inside Qwen-RLCD generation
books.subsystem: Explain ordinary autoregressive output, shared-context prefill, independent batched field queries, permitted-token scoring, collision continuation, and direct typed assembly. Distinguish the intended corrected algorithm from the current native reference and browser prototype.

books.title: Decisions Become Actions
books.subtitle: Turning a model choice into a checked browser move
books.subsystem: Bridge structured classification to browser actions using observation-bound joint candidates, typed arguments, live locator resolution, and one-action-then-observe execution. A Chrome extension and a native Playwright runner have different powers.

books.title: Recordings Become Practice
books.subtitle: How browser history becomes a training dataset
books.subsystem: Explain causal extraction from eligible Replay and rrweb recordings, local storage, provenance, held-out splits, behavior cloning, teacher labels, and local training/export. Historical recordings are observations, not counterfactual simulators.

books.title: A Fast Path with a Thoughtful Fallback
books.subtitle: How a small policy and GLM can work together
books.subsystem: Describe the proposed GLM teacher/planner/fallback relationship, independently test constrained decoding feasibility at larger scale, and evaluate complete task success and latency with recovery included.

books.title: Tab Into the Future
books.subtitle: A browser that meets you halfway
books.subsystem: Close with an opt-in predictive focus experience: learn supported personal patterns, suggest a target, accept via Tab without activation, preserve ordinary keyboard behavior, and collect non-self-reinforcing feedback. End with a concrete incremental pilot.
